svg.title: EasyTrip app flow: 2 · Key flows
svg.text: Rules checked in the browser today
• From and To are filled in and not the same place
• Departure is today or later; return is on/after departure
• 1–9 travelers; cabin, seat or class is chosen
• Phone is optional: 6–17 digits, + ( ) - and spaces only
The planners and stay details stop at a summary,
so nothing is booked yet. The dashed steps arrive
with the backend. Online payment is out of scope.

text.tspan: Page 2 of 2 · Validation, authentication and reservation in more detail
Runs today on the flight, bus & train and contact forms
Planned: Node.js + Express API with the USERS table
Stay or trip → BOOKINGS / TICKETS tables
